notes.subject: circumcised in uncircumcision
notes.rationale: על כל מול בערלה: 'punish all who are circumcised in (their) uncircumcision' — circumcised in flesh yet uncircumcised in heart, or a list of circumcised-plus-uncircumcised nations; translators divide.

notes.subject: ol de i kamap
notes.rationale: 'days are coming' formula announcing a fixed future time of reckoning.

translation: Lukim, ol de i kamap nau, tok bilong Yahwe, na bai mi skelim olgeta man ol i katim skin bilongen — ol i stap yet olsem man bilong skin nogut.

tokens.gloss: man ol i katim skin bilongen
